name: xui-zhushou
description: 带用户、订单、权益和配额管理的 3x-ui 商业部署助手

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild server/admin-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/admin-cli.cjs
scripts.test: tsx --test server/commercial-api.test.ts server/commercial-store.test.ts server/payment-service.test.ts server/inbound-builder.test.ts server/ssh.test.ts server/validation.test.ts server/xray-template.test.ts server/xui-client.test.ts
